findings: LangGraph 1.2.9 and Pydantic AI 2.13.0 show identical correctness: 15/20 (75%) each.
3 of 4 tasks: 100% completion for both frameworks.

refund-policy-minimal-tools: 0% for both. gpt-4o-mini computes days_since_delivery=19 (inclusive both endpoints) and then incorrectly concludes eligible=false. This is a model reasoning error, not a framework defect.
PydanticAI wall time is ~1.9x LangGraph (async-to-sync run_sync overhead).
Identical token counts across both frameworks confirm equivalent API payloads for all tasks.

oom_incident.description: Parent runner process OOM-killed after 34/40 runs (exit 137). 6 missing runs resumed in separate bounded script. All 40 results verified.
oom_incident.mitigations_for_future: Run scored pilot in bounded batches of ≤10 from a fresh process.
